Entries.Text: Find groups, fields and values in the selected file by name and value. Fill in any of the inputs: empty inputs are ignored, and the rest must all match. The deepest input filled in decides what is found: groups, fields or field values. Click a result to jump to it.

Find files, groups, fields and values in every file in the project by name and value. Fill in any of the inputs: empty inputs are ignored, and the rest must all match. The deepest input filled in decides what is found: files, groups, fields or field values. Click a result to open its file and jump to it.
Search the whole of the selected file, or only the selected group or field.
Match the file name or alias.
Match the internal or annotated name of a group.
Match the internal or annotated name of a field.

Match the value rows of fields by value, ID or time of day, as chosen on the left. A value also matches by its enum option name. Write vectors and colours as numbers separated by commas (colours as R, G, B, A).
The part of a value row to match against.
The value contains the text. With Exact Match, it must equal the text, and numbers are compared as numbers.

The value equals the input. Numbers are compared as numbers, so 1 finds 1.0. A vector or colour matches a list with the same number of components, or a single number that any of its components equals.
The value doesn't equal the input.
The value is less than the number. For a vector or colour, any component counts.
The value is less than or equal to the number. For a vector or colour, any component counts.
The value is greater than the number. For a vector or colour, any component counts.
The value is greater than or equal to the number. For a vector or colour, any component counts.
The value is between the two numbers, inclusive. For a vector or colour, any component counts.
The range, inclusive. Either end can be empty.
How the inputs are matched and the results listed.
Inputs must equal the text instead of being contained in it. Numbers are compared as numbers, so 1 finds 1.0.
List only the first result for each value found, to see which values are in use.
Run the search, or start over.
Run the search. Leaving an input after changing it, or pressing Enter in it, does the same.
Clear the inputs and the results.
The search runs in the background. Results are listed as they are found.
Stop the search. Results found so far are kept.
Click a result to jump to it. The filter narrows the list without searching again.
More than {0} results; only the first {0} are shown. Narrow the search to see the rest.
Find these results again in Mass Edit, to edit, delete or duplicate them all at once.
The search result no longer exists. Search again.
